Finished and liked the series · Sync to Stremio

Send existing and future “More like this” choices as Liked, and watched/finished choices as watched history, to the connected Stremio account. Existing Loved ratings stay Loved. Watchly will be asked to refresh; its update may take time. Not interested stays local. Clearing a local choice does not undo changes already sent.
